name: Jephthah's Daughter
title: Sacrificed in Faithfulness
summary: Jephthah's daughter was the only child of the judge Jephthah. She was sacrificed as a result of her father's rash vow to God after his victory over the Ammonites. Her story is a tragic example of the consequences of unwise vows and her own acceptance of her father's oath.

keyEvents.title: The Father's Vow
keyEvents.description: Before the battle against the Ammonites, Jephthah made a vow to sacrifice whatever came out of his house first if he won. This vow would have tragic consequences.

keyEvents.title: The Meeting After Victory
keyEvents.description: After the victory over the Ammonites, Jephthah's daughter came out to meet him with tambourines and dancing. She was his only child, and Jephthah was devastated by his vow.

keyEvents.title: Acceptance of the Father's Vow
keyEvents.description: With remarkable courage, she accepted her father's vow and asked only for two months to wander in the mountains and mourn her virginity with her friends.

keyEvents.title: Fulfillment of the Vow
keyEvents.description: After two months, she returned to her father, who fulfilled the vow he had made. She had never known a man.

keyEvents.title: Annual Commemoration
keyEvents.description: It became a custom in Israel that the daughters of Israel would go each year for four days to commemorate Jephthah's daughter from Gilead.
